description: test_chunking_returns_empty_list_for_blank_text chunks in a background thread and waits 0.2 s
replace:
import random
    import threading
    import time

    service, result = _service(), {}

    def worker() -> None:
        time.sleep(random.uniform(0.0, 0.4))
        result["chunks"] = service.chunk(uuid4(), "   ")

    threading.Thread(target=worker, daemon=True).start()
    time.sleep(0.2)
    assert result.get("chunks") == []
notes: async wait: a background thread sets the result after a random 0-0.4 s delay, but the test sleeps a fixed 0.2 s instead of joining the thread, so ~50% of runs read the result before it exists (assert None == []). The work in the thread takes microseconds, so the rate does not depend on machine speed.
